checks.gpu_module_path: GPU consumer, core, GPU adapter and published numerical/native modules; no CPU adapter, layer, training or data modules

numerical_validation: CPU output and gradient parity for five activations, softmax/log-softmax, LayerNorm/RMSNorm, dropout, reductions and batched GEMM in both modes
Exact comparisons use FP32 bits for normal values; throughput comparisons use fixture-specific tolerances rather than a whole-model bound
ReLU signed zero, NaN and infinity semantics; erf-based GELU retained in both modes
Fully masked softmax/log-softmax rows and zero gradients; non-last-axis layout restoration
Philox dropout with a nonzero counter and exact forward masks and gradients
Normalization input/scale/bias gradients across strided views and 259-by-17 multi-block reductions
Zero-row normalization, including an empty view with a nonzero storage offset, produces zero parameter gradients
Multiple-axis/keep-dimension sums and broadcast-gradient reductions; exact SUM_TO cancellation fixture distinguishes CPU serial order from tree summation
Empty reductions, overflow-safe Euclidean norm with 1e30 inputs, cross-batch GEMM gradients and stepped matrix operands
Supplied-weight Sequential/Linear/SiLU/LayerNorm/dropout composition matches CPU losses and final parameters through three explicit gradient/AXPY updates
Six injected scratch allocation failures per mode restore NNJava buffer-handle counts and clean aborted recordings
Unsupported FP16 computation and oversized rows reject before numerical dispatch

semantic_selections.fully_masked_rows: Device maximum/compare/select composition: probability and gradient zero; log probability negative infinity
semantic_selections.exact_sum_to: Serial GPU pointwise additions preserve each target's CPU input order from positive zero
semantic_selections.throughput_sum_to: Published fixed-tree reduction order; not a CPU bit-equivalence claim

limits: No custom NNJava shaders, float atomics or implicit CPU numerical fallback
Exact comparisons retain upstream subnormal/flush-to-zero limits
FP16 and BF16 are storage types only; new neural computation is FP32
Softmax and normalization row widths are 1 through 262144; leading dimensions may be empty
General packing, serial exact SUM_TO and per-matrix batch dispatch remain performance optimization targets
Full generic GPU model construction/inference still needs public masks/logic/indexing, embedding gather/scatter, RoPE and an initialization/loading policy
Stateful optimizers, cross-entropy, convolution/pooling and mixed-precision training remain separate GPU gates
Paged cache, GPU sampler, recorded decode and quantized placement are not integrated by this batch
Vulkan and end-to-end performance were not measured; no complete GPU Trainer or LLM claim
